title: MCP assistants gain text and audio tools
summary:
Assistants gained text and audio tools, two chat models joined the lineup, and the community gallery picked up new projects.

The Pollinations MCP server expanded beyond images: assistants can now generate text, produce spoken responses, read supplied text aloud, and discover available models and voices. A new JavaScript documentation example also shows how to transcribe audio.

Added `mistral-roblox` and `phi-mini` to text chat. OpenAI-compatible chat requests are now private by default; the same update set an 8,000-token maximum for Qwen Coder on Scaleway and switched Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite to its non-preview model ID.

Added Azad-sl’s Chinese-language text-to-speech project and FreeAI, which combines chat, image generation, and voice synthesis. OkeyAI API Playground was removed from the project listings.

highlights.title: MCP can speak now
highlights.text: Let an AI assistant generate text, produce a spoken response, or read your text aloud. The MCP server also lists available models and voices. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Mistral Roblox joins chat
highlights.text: Try `mistral-roblox`, a Mistral chat model routed through Scaleway. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-roblox).

highlights.title: Phi Mini joins chat
highlights.text: Try `phi-mini`, powered by Phi-4 Mini Instruct on Azure. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi-mini).
